references.title: 2022 American College of Rheumatology/American Association of Hip and Knee Surgeons Guideline for the Perioperative Management of Antirheumatic Medication in Patients With Rheumatic Diseases Undergoing Elective Total Hip or Total Knee Arthroplasty
references.quote_excerpt: For patients with SLE (not severe) undergoing THA or TKA, withholding the current dose of mycophenolate mofetil, mycophenolic acid, azathioprine, cyclosporine, mizoribine, or tacrolimus 1 week prior to surgery is conditionally recommended. ... For patients with severe SLE who have been deemed appropriate to undergo THA or TKA, continuing the usual dose of mycophenolate mofetil, mycophenolic acid (Myfortic), azathioprine, mizoribine, cyclosporine, or tacrolimus, anifrolumab, and voclosporin through surgery is conditionally recommended.
references.quote_translation_excerpt: 非重症 SLE 患者では、 待機的 人工膝/股関節全置換術の 1 週間前から MMF / ミコフェノール酸 / アザチオプリン / シクロスポリン / ミゾリビン / タクロリムス を中止することを条件付きで推奨。 重症 SLE (organ-threatening disease、 lupus 腎炎 / CNS lupus / 血管炎 等) 患者では 同薬剤の通常用量継続を条件付きで推奨 (主治医リウマチ専門医と相談)
references.location_in_source: p.4 Table 2 下段 (Not severe SLE: withhold 1 week prior) + p.5 Recommendations + Severe SLE-specific 上段
